name: Context7 MCP
tagline: Up-to-date library docs, fetched for the agent.
description: Upstash's Context7 MCP server resolves a library name to a docs ID and returns version-specific documentation for the question at hand. Stops the agent quoting stale training data. Published as @upstash/context7-mcp. An API key is recommended for higher rate limits.
author: Upstash
notes: Remote HTTP endpoint also exists at https://mcp.context7.com/mcp.
